sources.title: GRM-3.2-Sky: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview GRM-3.2-Sky is a text-to-text model from OrionLLM, released under the Apache 2.0 License. Its primary purpose is long-horizon agentic work and difficult reasoning across coding, mathematics, logic, planning, tool use, and self-correction. The model uses the Ornith-1.0-35B architecture: a 35-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with about 3 billion active parameters per inference ...

sources.snippet: Krea 2 OSS - Optimized FP8 Weights (Turbo) This repository provides an optimized FP8 (float8_e4m3fn) weight-only quantized version of the newly released Krea 2 OSS (Turbo) transformer.
